segment.source: Renders a full-width notice strip fused to the top of the opening band — one sentence and a link — with the ordinary headline, lead and action underneath it. Use it for: release announcements, funding news, a conference date, a pricing change, a migration deadline, a service window. Prefer 'Event Hero' when the announcement is the whole page rather than a line above it, and 'Product Hero' when nothing needs flagging above the headline.
